pairs.subject: render-mount-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:89 The landing page renders a short list as plain React JSX. HomeLists maps every fetched row (capped by .limit(12) and .limit(24)) to a ListCard, and the backdrop is a static SVG scene. React reconciliation decides which elements exist, not product code, so the subject's precondition does not hold. A search of src/app and src for virtualiz, overscan, recycl, premount and getContext( found nothing.

techniques.evidence: src/app/page.tsx:46 There is no layout pass of its own and no blueprint handed to a mount pass. The page composes React components, and the framework mounts them.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:58 The lists have a fixed cap and are fully mounted. Nothing is windowed and scroll does no mount work.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:98 There is one item kind, keyed by id through React. No host-object pool exists.
src/v2/brand/Backdrop.tsx:13 No visibility window can unmount anything, so no feature needs to hold an element mounted. The backdrop is always mounted and decorative.
